title: TypeScript provider result frame
description: The frame the provider writes for one query, mirrored from the envelope its builder constructs and from the closed-schema validation that admits it.

sourceContract.authority: bend2/context/typescript/lib/protocol.mjs (validateResult :251-290); the built envelope is lib/query.mjs:118-155 and the frame is written by provider.mjs
sourceContract.drift: validateResult is the authority for admission and query.mjs is the authority for the members a published result carries; this document is their admitted mirror, so a change to either requires a change here. validateResult admits version 1 (:251), requires facts, relations, refs and limits to be arrays (:254-256), requires every fact and relation to carry a nonempty unique id (:258-262), a classification from CLASSIFICATIONS (:33, :263) and a nonempty evidence array (:264), requires every ref to carry a nonempty unique id (:265-270) and the snapshot identity in use (:271-277), and requires a record inside a value to carry the snapshot identity in use (:278-283).
sourceContract.identityNote: no $id is set: the admitted identity is a hole for package admission to fill, named by the inventory it admits.

crossFieldRules.detail: an id repeated across facts and relations refuses with result-ids-not-unique
a classification outside observed, static-possible, checked and declared refuses with result-classification-invalid
a fact or relation with no evidence member, or with an empty evidence array, refuses with result-evidence-missing
every ref names the snapshot identity of this result, and a ref naming another one refuses with result-ref-snapshot-mismatch
a record carried inside a fact or relation value names the snapshot identity of this result, and another one refuses with result-record-snapshot-mismatch
the builder replaces its pending marker with the identity computed over the captured input closure before the result is returned, and refuses to return a result in which the marker survives
